prompt:
Generate a transparent game SPRITE SHEET of nine trees. Use the attached geometry as the elevated isometric CAMERA guide: top faces are very visible, trunks short below the canopy, radial branch spread in the horizontal2:1 plane. Replace the simple geometry with restrained painted organic trees. IMPORTANT remove every green ground diamond completely to alpha0. Do NOT return frontal tree illustrations. Camera looks down onto the TOP of crowns from35 degrees elevation, fixed orthographic three-quarter view. Crown tops and layered radial foliage dominate, crowns conceal inner trunk forks. Northwest light, muted sage and deep olive greens, warm brown wood. Full plants with clear empty gutters in exactly3x3 equal square cells. No tiny leaves or needles, lettering or UI. Root foot near85% cell height; canopy and branches wholly contained in its own cell. 
Subjects ONLY from this list, keep botanical identity but canopy view overrides any frontal trunk/fork description. Cold blue/sage green with restrained snow on canopy TOP surfaces and pale trunks.
Slot 1: black-spruce, 8.67m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Narrow irregular dark blue-green spire with separated snowy branch ledges.
Slot 2: white-spruce, 10m tall, 197.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Full cool sage-green conical crown with restrained ivory snow on upper boughs.
Slot 3: mountain-hemlock, 8.67m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Asymmetric drooping blue-green evergreen, crooked leader and light snow.
Slot 4: subalpine-fir, 10m tall, 197.2px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Slim dense pointed dark green crown with broad pale snow bands.
Slot 5: siberian-larch, 9.33m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Open golden olive conical crown, clear horizontal branches and cool bark.
Slot 6: tamarack, 8.67m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Airy narrow muted bronze-green needle crown on a tall exposed brown trunk.
Slot 7: northern-lodgepole-pine, 9.33m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Thin upright rugged pine with a small narrow crown and snowy branch forks.
Slot 8: limber-pine, 8m tall, 157.8px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Crooked open grey trunk, spreading dark needle cushions and a bent leader.
Slot 9: bristlecone-pine, 6.67m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Sculptural twisted pale ancient trunk, sparse separated dark foliage cushions.
Relative size comes from metre heights; do not fit all plants to equal heights. Complete crown and root foot, no ground discs. 12% empty gutter. Natural irregular foliage, visible radial crown TOPS conceal80% of trunks.
